product.description: The LumenField Solar Path Light 12V offers a reliable, energy‑efficient illumination solution for gardens, walkways, and patios. Its 12‑V DC LED array delivers up to 150 lumens, while a built‑in solar panel charges a rechargeable 2000 mAh battery during daylight, allowing continuous operation for up to 8 hours after sunset. The lantern’s polycarbonate housing and aluminum frame provide weather‑resistant durability, and the matte black finish blends seamlessly with natural surroundings. A simple pull‑cord switch and adjustable mounting bracket enable easy installation on posts or walls. Ideal for eco‑conscious homeowners and landscaping projects, this light combines sustainable power with low maintenance.
